title: certificate path search over ambiguous issuers is bounded and engine-independent
purpose: Audit S02 (#17): ambiguous issuers must end in a defined refusal within the search budget while valid alternative chains still verify.

stdout.text:
unreachable anchor: CertificateVerificationFailed.because(CertificateFailure.invalid_chain)
dead end: limit exceeded
budget 4 peers: CertificateVerificationFailed.because(CertificateFailure.invalid_chain)
budget 5 peers: limit exceeded
single dead end: CertificateVerificationFailed.because(CertificateFailure.invalid_chain)
forged issuers: path ca-leaf ca root
valid first: path ca-leaf ca root
forged only: CertificateVerificationFailed.because(CertificateFailure.invalid_signature)

provenance.origin: authored for #17 from the audit 2026-11-01 S02 finding
provenance.expected_basis: Issuers whose anchor is unreachable and links whose signature fails are skipped; a search spends at most 1024 steps (a considered issuer, or a link of a path validated at an anchor) and then fails with resource_exhausted (CertificateLimitExceeded). Self-issued peers that sign each other: 4 peers before a dead end exhaust the paths within the budget (invalid_chain), 5 do not (limit). Forged issuers with the anchor's name are skipped, leaving leaf, CA and root.
